method: Agro-climatic zone climatology adjusted for the current ICPAC seasonal outlook. NOT output of the fitted seasonal model; when that model runs it will add a 'cells' block at grid resolution which takes precedence.
headline_source: ICPAC OND 2026 outlook + Beelove zone climatology
disclaimer: Read alongside the official Kenya Meteorological Department forecast and what you can see in your own field.

2026-09.label: September 2026
2026-09.action: SHORT RAINS APPROACHING - stronger than normal expected. Move hives OFF flood-prone ground now. Check stands are above the flood line and roofs and ventilation are sound.

2026-10.label: October 2026
2026-10.action: HEAVY SHORT RAINS. Inspect apiaries after every storm for flooding and hive damage. Bees fly little in continuous rain - leave their stores alone.
2026-10.source: ICPAC OND 2026: 90% chance enhanced rainfall NE Kenya; >400mm central Kenya

2026-11.label: November 2026
2026-11.action: PEAK WET SEASON. A strong bloom follows this rain. Clean and bait spare hives NOW - heavy flowering brings swarming and free colonies to anyone who is ready.
2026-11.source: ICPAC OND 2026 outlook; El Nino + positive IOD

2026-12.label: December 2026
2026-12.action: Bloom building. Keep bait hives out. Do NOT harvest wet - test moisture before extracting anything.

2027-01.label: January 2027
2027-01.action: Main harvest window. Test EVERY batch with the refractometer - wet-season honey above 20% moisture will ferment and is not sellable.

2027-02.label: February 2027
2027-02.action: Post-harvest. Consolidate weak colonies and treat empty boxes for wax moth while they are off the hives.

2027-03.label: March 2027
2027-03.action: Long rains beginning. Re-check drainage and hive stands before the ground softens.
2027-03.source: Seasonal normal; IOD/ENSO signal weak in MAM

2027-04.label: April 2027
2027-04.action: Long rains bloom. Add supers to strong colonies and keep spare boxes ready.
2027-04.source: Seasonal normal; IOD/ENSO signal weak in MAM

2027-05.label: May 2027
2027-05.action: Good forage. Watch for swarming - split strong colonies before they leave.

2027-06.label: June 2027
2027-06.action: Forage declining. Leave enough stores in the hive; do not over-harvest.

2027-07.label: July 2027
2027-07.action: Dry season. Put clean water near the apiary and reduce entrances against robbing.

2027-08.label: August 2027
2027-08.action: Driest period. Monitor hive weight. Feed only colonies that are genuinely light.

western_highlands.name: Western highlands and lake basin
western_highlands.regime: Rain through most of the year, peaking with the long rains. The short rains matter less here than anywhere else in Kenya.

2026-09.label: September 2026
2026-09.action: Short rains building on ground that is already wet. Your risk this season is waterlogging, not drought - check hive stands and drainage now.
2026-09.source: ICPAC OND 2026 outlook, 18 Aug 2026, weighted by zone sensitivity

2026-10.label: October 2026
2026-10.action: Heavy, persistent rain. Bees cannot fly in it. Leave stores alone and do not open hives more than you must.
2026-10.source: ICPAC OND 2026 outlook, 18 Aug 2026, weighted by zone sensitivity

2026-11.label: November 2026
2026-11.action: Strong bloom, but expect fewer flying hours than the greenery suggests. Bait spare hives - swarms will move.
2026-11.source: ICPAC OND 2026 outlook, 18 Aug 2026, weighted by zone sensitivity

2026-12.label: December 2026
2026-12.action: Bloom holding. Do NOT harvest wet - test moisture before extracting or the honey ferments.
2026-12.source: ICPAC OND 2026 outlook, 18 Aug 2026, weighted by zone sensitivity

northern_arid.name: Northern arid and semi-arid
northern_arid.regime: Dry for most of the year. When rain comes it decides the whole season's forage.

2026-09.label: September 2026
2026-09.action: This rain decides your whole season. Get hives out of dry riverbeds and off flat ground that floods.
2026-09.source: ICPAC OND 2026 outlook, 18 Aug 2026, weighted by zone sensitivity

2026-10.label: October 2026
2026-10.action: Heavy rain in country that sheds it fast. Flash flooding is the danger - move anything sited near a luggah or drainage line.
2026-10.source: ICPAC OND 2026 outlook, 18 Aug 2026, weighted by zone sensitivity

2026-11.label: November 2026
2026-11.action: The big flush. This is the one month worth having every spare hive baited and ready.
2026-11.source: ICPAC OND 2026 outlook, 18 Aug 2026, weighted by zone sensitivity

2026-12.label: December 2026
2026-12.action: Forage still strong. Harvest only what the colony can spare, and test moisture before extracting.

northeastern_arid.name: North-eastern arid
northeastern_arid.regime: The short rains dominate almost completely. ICPAC puts the strongest enhanced-rainfall signal in the country here this season.

2026-09.label: September 2026
2026-09.action: ICPAC puts a 90% chance of enhanced rain over this region. Move hives to high ground BEFORE the rains break, not after.
2026-09.source: ICPAC OND 2026 outlook, 18 Aug 2026, weighted by zone sensitivity

2026-10.label: October 2026
2026-10.action: HIGHEST FLOOD RISK IN THE COUNTRY this season. Check apiaries after every storm. Do not site hives near seasonal watercourses.
2026-10.source: ICPAC OND 2026 outlook, 18 Aug 2026, weighted by zone sensitivity

2026-11.label: November 2026
2026-11.action: Peak rain and the strongest bloom this region gets. Bait every spare hive - but keep them above the flood line.

2026-12.label: December 2026
2026-12.action: Bloom holding. Wet-season honey ferments above 20% moisture - test every batch before extracting.

coastal.name: Coastal strip
coastal.regime: Wettest around the long rains and just after. The short rains are a secondary season here.

2026-09.label: September 2026
2026-09.action: Short rains approaching, wetter than normal. Check that hives are off ground that holds water.
2026-09.source: ICPAC OND 2026 outlook, 18 Aug 2026, weighted by zone sensitivity

2026-10.label: October 2026
2026-10.action: Steady rain. Humidity is the problem here as much as flooding - keep ventilation clear and roofs sound.
2026-10.source: ICPAC OND 2026 outlook, 18 Aug 2026, weighted by zone sensitivity

2026-11.label: November 2026
2026-11.action: Good secondary bloom. Bait spare hives, and watch for swarming.

2026-12.label: December 2026
2026-12.action: Bloom easing. Test moisture carefully before extracting - coastal humidity keeps honey wet.
